reviews.paraphrase: Name the kind of failure that would force the scheduling pilot to stop, even if it reduced staff work.
reviews.naturalAnswer: A scheduling error that leaves a vulnerable client without an essential visit would stop the pilot.

reviews.paraphrase: Set the number of unsafe journeys in each 1,000 scheduled journeys that would trigger stopping the rollout.
reviews.naturalAnswer: The third unsafe journey in any 1,000 scheduled journeys would stop the rollout.

reviews.paraphrase: Set the minimum number out of every 100 vulnerable clients who must keep the same carer without Elena intervening before expansion.
reviews.naturalAnswer: At least 90 out of every 100 vulnerable clients must keep the same carer without me stepping in before expansion.

reviews.paraphrase: Choose which of three benefits repeat clients most often said brought them back.
Say whether any client used the monthly product without a senior researcher and reported that its challenge changed their decision.
Set the minimum number of clients who must buy the new service again before half the team moves to it.
reviews.naturalAnswer: Five clients must pay for the new service again before I move half the team.

reviews.paraphrase: Decide whether the planners' roles should still change if the same planners meet the target once they have accurate information and fair targets.
Decide whether one plant must reach at least 91 percent on-time delivery with the same planners before all six plants receive funding.
Choose the human role that should have the final decision when an AI plan risks making a customer late.
reviews.naturalAnswer: The planner responsible for the order.

reviews.paraphrase: Choose the ticket-buyer group whose increased purchases are required before moving GBP 18 million.
Decide whether comparable ticket sales must identify the campaign that gains new viewers without reducing core-fan sales before moving GBP 18 million.
Set the extra ticket buyers required per 100 franchise-new viewers compared with today's campaign to justify GBP 18 million while core-fan sales stay level.
reviews.naturalAnswer: Five extra ticket buyers per 100 franchise-new viewers, compared with today's campaign under similar release conditions, would justify the GBP 18 million if core-fan sales do not fall.

limitations: This is an adult plain-language proxy review of fictional cases using only the visible reader brief and question pack.
It does not establish child comprehension, factual accuracy or product efficacy.
